user.title: Connect to DeepSeek Harness
user.description: Point Home Assistant at the bridge plugin running inside DeepSeek Harness on your PC.

data_description.host: LAN address of the PC running DeepSeek Harness.
data_description.port: Port the bridge plugin listens on (default 43131).
data_description.token: Open http://127.0.0.1:43131/ on the PC running DeepSeek Harness to read (or rotate) it.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh the bridge token
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge at {host} rejected the stored token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bridge. Check the address, the port, and that the dsh-ha-bridge plugin is installed and DeepSeek Harness is running.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.

data_description.panel_title: Label of this host in the sidebar; every host gets its own panel. Leave it empty to use the name Home Assistant gave the entry.
data_description.web_port: Port the ha-workbench plugin listens on (default 43132).
data_description.web_mode: proxied streams the GUI through Home Assistant, so it also works through a tunnel. direct frames the PC's own address, which only works on the LAN.

send_prompt.name: Send prompt
send_prompt.description: Queue or steer a prompt into a DeepSeek Harness session.

cancel.name: Cancel run
cancel.description: Cancel the active turn of a session without dropping its queue.

wait.name: Wait for result
wait.description: Wait until a session settles and return its trailing messages.
